name: QueryPie AI
long_description: QueryPie AI is an enterprise AI platform designed to securely operate AI agents in enterprise environments. Built on an MCP-based architecture, it connects internal data and diverse business systems while enforcing access control and centralized management. This enables organizations to execute AI Transformation (AX) with security as a foundation and extend AI adoption into practical automation and tangible business outcomes.

founders.full_name: Benjamin Yang, Director of product development
founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio:
Benjamin is an open-minded IDE expert who has been developing IDE databases for 15 years. He is now a full-time cloud-based PaaS developer, with a 21-year experience in software development and a bachelor's degree in computer science from Hanshin University.

Ben's IDE expertise and data connectivity foundation enable the company to provide top-notch SQL editing, querying, and collaboration tools to QueryPie's development team, enabling seamless data governance and data analytics integration.
